goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Chancen und Risiken von Unternehmenskonzentration erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Four separate shops versus two demonstrate supplier concentration. Balanced gear/choice scale marks efficiency potential versus fewer independent suppliers. It does not show price increases or declare concentration invariably harmful.
actualInspection.phone: 360 px preserves four-versus-two storefront structure and central balanced gear/bicycle comparison. Tiny decorative shop poster is not needed to read the concept.
actualInspection.desktop: 680 px shows friendly suppliers and thoughtful customers; scale labels and main headings are readable.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Shop signs and neutral comparison scale face the viewer; no actor-dependent chart/document inversion.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Weniger Auswahl is read with the visibly reduced supplier choice; image is not evidence that a concentrated supplier necessarily sells fewer product variants.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
